definitions.explanation: A device used to measure quantities such as pressure, speed, or temperature.

examples.japanese: {計器|けいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数値|すうち}→数値：12913_suuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認：00158_kakunin⟧。
examples.english: Check the readings on the gauges.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{計器|けいき}パネル⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多|おお}くの→多い：01127_ooi⟧{計器|けいき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are many instruments on an airplane's instrument panel.

examples.japanese: {計器|けいき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{故障|こしょう}した→故障：01405_koshou⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{正確|せいかく}な→正確：03372_seikaku⟧⟦{測定|そくてい}→測定：04398_sokutei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できなかった→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: The meter broke down, so accurate measurement was not possible.

notes:
{計器|けいき} refers to measuring instruments in general, from simple meters to complex instrument panels.

TYPES:
- ⟦{温度計|おんどけい}→温度計：25699_ondokei⟧ (thermometer)
- {速度計|そくどけい} (speedometer)
- {圧力計|あつりょくけい} (pressure gauge)
- {高度計|こうどけい} (altimeter)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {計器|けいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (read a gauge)
- {計器|けいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認：00158_kakunin⟧ (check instruments)
- {計器|けいき}{飛行|ひこう} (instrument flight)
- {計器|けいき}パネル (instrument panel)

WATCH OUT:
⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧ (economic conditions; business climate) - different kanji and meaning.
